analysis.original_request: 为可见光吸热涂料的光谱选择性表面设计吸收膜：在 400-700 nm 可见波段吸收率尽可能高（反射率尽可能低），而在 700-2000 nm 近红外波段反射率尽可能高以抑制热输入。请在空气入射、铝基底条件下，仅使用 HfO2 和 SiO2 与金属 Cr 设计一个平面多层膜，膜系总层数不超过 20 层。
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design an absorption film for a spectrally selective surface for visible light heat-absorbing coating: maximize absorptance (minimize reflectance) in the 400-700 nm visible band, and maximize reflectance in the 700-2000 nm near-infrared band to suppress heat input. Conditions: unspecified material incidence, unspecified material substrate. Use only HfO2, SiO2, and metal Cr to design a planar multilayer film. Total layer count must not exceed 20 layers.
analysis.compatibility_reason: The request specifies a planar multilayer film with isotropic linear materials under plane-wave illumination, which fits the TMM solver scope.
known_stack_materials: Allowed film materials: HfO2, SiO2, Cr
method_research_questions: Optimal arrangement of HfO2, SiO2, and Cr layers to achieve spectral selectivity
